subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank to complete the idiom and make the sentence meaningful.

During the interview, the candidate was challenged to provide chapter and _______ on his proposed plan.
solution:
The correct answer is '**verse**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "chapter and verse" means providing detailed information or evidence.
 
• It is often used to emphasize the thoroughness or completeness of the provided information.
 
• The other options: "page," "lines," and "cover" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *During the interview, the candidate was challenged to provide chapter and verse__ on his proposed plan.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Page (पृष्ठ)**: means one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, etc.
 
• **Lines (पंक्तियाँ)**: means a row of written or printed words.
 
• **Cover (आवरण)**: means something that covers or conceals an object.
